content_metadata.description: This video is an educational piece about the hybridization and geometry of carbon atoms in organic molecules. It uses text on screen, diagrams, and a voiceover to explain the concepts.

qAndA.question: How many single bonds does a carbon atom have in sp3 hybridization?
What type of bond is characteristic of sp2 hybridization?
What is the name of the molecule shown as an example of sp hybridization?

qAndA.answer: By showing chemical structures containing single, double, and triple bonds, respectively.

narrativeProgression.description: Shifts focus from hybridization to geometry, explaining how each hybridization state corresponds to a specific molecular geometry.
Section Title: 'GEOMETRY CARBON'
Geometry and Bonds: The scene sequentially explains the geometry of carbon atoms with different hybridizations and their corresponding number of bonds:
'sp3: 1s + 3p = 4 bonds - tetrahedral'
'sp2: 1s + 2p = 3 bonds - trigonal planar'
'sp: 1s + 1p = 2 bonds - linear'
